description: Machine-readable list of the places where rop-finder DELIBERATELY does
not reproduce ROPgadget's output, so that the parity harness can hold
every other fixture to bit-exactness instead of loosening the whole
gate. A divergence that is not in this file is a regression.
Consumed by tests/parity.py: for each entry whose `fixture` matches the
fixture under test, the harness must apply `effect` before comparing —
`extra-gadgets` means our set may be a strict superset restricted to
gadgets matching `match`, `disjoint-set` means the two sets are not
comparable at all and only the recorded `expect` is asserted, and
`text-only` means the (vaddr, bytes) sets must still match exactly while
the listed gadget texts may differ.
Every `oracle` / `ours` number in this file was measured on 2026-09-03
against ROPgadget 7.7 (pinned commit b6e3fe31af46) driven by the python

divergences.reason: ROPgadget opens EVERY RISC-V binary in CS_MODE_RISCV64 | CS_MODE_RISCVC (gadgets.py:202, 392, 479), including ELFCLASS32 ones. RV64-only text (`sd`, `ld`, `addiw`, `c.ldsp`, 64-bit register widths) is then printed for instructions an RV32 target cannot execute. rop-finder selects CS_MODE_RISCV32 for an ELFCLASS32 RISC-V image, so the (vaddr, bytes) set is IDENTICAL and 68 of the 279 gadget texts differ.

The PE header says IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARMNT, which is Thumb-2 ONLY — an ARMv7-M/ARMv7 Windows image contains no A32 instructions at all. ROPgadget scans it with the A32 anchor tables unless `--thumb` is passed, so its 38 gadgets are A32 misinterpretations of Thumb code. rop-finder routes a Thumb-only image to the Thumb tables automatically, which yields a completely different (and correct) gadget set.

ROPgadget's ARM64 and SPARC SYS anchor tables are literally empty — gadgets.py:443-446 is two `TODO` comments — so `--sys` returns nothing on AArch64, the architecture where a syscall gadget is the entire point of a SYS search. rop-finder populates them: AArch64 `svc #imm16` (0xd4000001 | imm16 << 5) and SPARC `ta %g0 + imm7` (0x91d02000 | imm7). Our gadget set is therefore a superset of the oracle's, and every extra gadget's text starts with `svc` or `ta`.

elf-ARM64-bash.note: dynamically linked bash contains no inline svc; the syscalls live in libc, so this fixture does not exercise the new table

elf-SparcV8-bash.note: same — no inline `ta` in the scanned segments
